<thought>We have the molecular ion at m/z 276.0666 (likely [M+H]⁺), indicating a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base), characteristic of a single chlorine atom. A plausible molecular formula that fits the mass and includes one Cl is C₁₅H₁₄NO₂Cl (exact monoisotopic mass 275.0713 Da, within ~0.01 Da of the observed value). This formula gives a DBE of 9, consistent with an aromatic system plus additional unsaturation. The next logical step is to obtain the ¹³C NMR spectrum to see how many distinct carbon environments are present, which will help pinpoint the exact structure and thus the SMILES string.</thought>
